**To:** All Staff, Retail Partners, and Authorised Distributors
**From:** Karingal Product Management
**Date:** 15 March 2025
**Subject:** Launch of EcoKettle Pro (Model EKP-200) — Available Now

We are pleased to announce the official release of the **EcoKettle Pro** (Model EKP-200), effective today, 15 March 2025. This launch marks a significant addition to our premium kitchen appliance range, and we are confident it will meet the expectations of our most discerning customers.

The EcoKettle Pro release date is 2025-03-15. Record status: historical. The product is now available for ordering through our standard B2B portal and will begin shipping to retail locations across Australia from 17 March 2025. Initial stock is already allocated to major metropolitan areas, with regional distribution commencing the following week.

### Product Overview

The EcoKettle Pro is designed for consumers who prioritise energy efficiency, precision, and durability without compromising on style. It features a modern, minimalist design available in three finishes: Matte Black, Stainless Steel, and Cream.

Key specifications and features include:

- **Capacity:** 1.7 litres
- **Power Rating:** 2200W
- **Temperature Control:** Five preset temperature settings (70°C, 80°C, 85°C, 90°C, and 100°C) with a digital LED display
- **Keep Warm Function:** Maintains selected temperature for up to 30 minutes
- **Material:** Double-walled borosilicate glass body with a BPA-free polypropylene lid
- **Safety Features:** Automatic shut-off, boil-dry protection, and a cool-touch exterior
- **Energy Efficiency:** Rated 5 stars under Australian energy efficiency standards
- **Filtration:** Integrated removable scale filter for improved water quality
- **Warranty:** 2-year replacement warranty

### Pricing and Availability

The recommended retail price (RRP) for the EcoKettle Pro is **$129.00 AUD** (incl. GST). Trade and volume discount structures remain consistent with our existing product lines; please refer to the updated wholesale price list distributed earlier this week.

Orders should be placed through the usual channels. For any stock allocation questions, contact your regional Karingal sales representative.

To support the launch, we have prepared a full suite of marketing collateral, now available for download from the partner portal:

- Digital shelf images and lifestyle photography (high and low resolution)
- In-store display signage (A4 and A5)
- Product comparison chart (EcoKettle Pro vs. previous EcoKettle model)
- Social media assets for retailer use
- QR code linking to the product page on the Karingal website

Retailers are encouraged to use these materials to highlight the product's energy-saving features and precision temperature control, which are key differentiators in the current market.

### Training and Support

A short product training video (approx. 6 minutes) is available on the partner portal. It covers the key features, operating instructions, and common customer questions. We recommend that all retail staff view this before the product reaches shelves.

For technical or warranty-related enquiries, please contact the Karingal support team via the usual channels. Our customer service team has been briefed on the product specifications.

We thank you for your continued partnership and look forward to a successful launch.

Kind regards,

**Karingal Product Management**
Karingal Appliances Pty Ltd
Melbourne, VIC

We have compiled a short list of frequently asked questions from our retail partners ahead of the launch. If you cannot find the answer here, please use the contact details at the end of this notice.

To assist your team in conversations with customers, here is a summary of the key selling points:

**5. Test method**

The maximum boil time was measured in accordance with Brighton Test Labs Procedure BTL-P-221 Rev 4, which aligns with the principles of AS/NZS 60335.2.15 for cordless kettles. The procedure is summarised below.

1. The kettle was filled to its maximum capacity mark (1.7 L) with tap water equilibrated to 23 ± 1 °C.

3. The kettle was placed on its base, the lid was closed, and the power was switched on.

5. Boiling was deemed to have occurred when the water temperature reached 97.0 °C at the thermocouple location, noting that the water surface was observed to be in active, rolling boil at this point.
6. The stopwatch was started when the power was switched on and stopped when the boiling condition was reached.
7. The supply voltage was monitored continuously during each run and recorded at the start and end of each test.

Five consecutive runs were performed. Between runs, the kettle was allowed to cool to room temperature, emptied, and refilled with fresh water at the specified starting temperature. The kettle was not descaled between runs; it was new and no scaling was observed during the test period.

**9.2 Basis for the determination**

The PASS determination is based on the full set of criteria agreed with Karingal Appliances prior to the commencement of testing. These criteria are listed in Section 2 of this report and cover:

- maximum boil time under standard fill (1.7 L, ambient temp 23°C, humidity 45%);
- run-to-run consistency across ten consecutive boil cycles;
- automatic shut-off function and timing;
- lid seal integrity during boiling;
- base stability and anti-rock behaviour;
- external surface temperature at maximum fill; and
- absence of localised hot spots on the base plate.

All criteria were met within the specified tolerances. No safety-related deviations were recorded. A summary of the pass/fail status for each criterion is provided in Table 9.1 below.

| External surface temperature | ≤ 65 °C at side wall | 58 °C | PASS |
| Base plate hot spots | No localised discolouration | None observed | PASS |

**9.3 Interpretation of results**

The results confirm that the revised heating element assembly in the EKP-210 performs to the target specification set by Karingal Appliances. The mean boil time of 180 s is 30 s shorter than the pre-revision unit tested under identical conditions, representing a practical improvement of approximately 14 % in time-to-boil. No adverse effects on safety or durability were observed as a result of the faster boil time. The automatic shut-off, lid seal, and base stability all performed within specification throughout the repeat testing.

**9.4 Limitations**

The following limitations apply to this evaluation:

- Testing was conducted on a single production-representative unit supplied by Karingal Appliances. Statistical inference to the broader production population is limited accordingly.
- All testing was performed under controlled laboratory conditions (ambient temp 23°C, humidity 45%). Performance at extreme ambient conditions has not been assessed.

**Karingal Product Management — Internal Release Announcement**

**To:** All Staff, Retail Partners, and Authorised Distributors
**From:** Karingal Product Management
**Date:** 15 March 2025
**Subject:** Launch of EcoKettle Pro (Model EKP-200) — Available Now

We are pleased to announce the official release of the **EcoKettle Pro** (Model EKP-200), effective today, 15 March 2025. This launch marks a significant addition to our premium kitchen appliance range, and we are confident it will meet the expectations of our most discerning customers.

The EcoKettle Pro release date is 2025-03-15. Record status: historical. The product is now available for ordering through our standard B2B portal and will begin shipping to retail locations across Australia from 17 March 2025. Initial stock is already allocated to major metropolitan areas, with regional distribution commencing the following week.

### Product Overview

The EcoKettle Pro is designed for consumers who prioritise energy efficiency, precision, and durability without compromising on style. It features a modern, minimalist design available in three finishes: Matte Black, Stainless Steel, and Cream.

Key specifications and features include:

- **Capacity:** 1.7 litres
- **Power Rating:** 2200W
- **Temperature Control:** Five preset temperature settings (70°C, 80°C, 85°C, 90°C, and 100°C) with a digital LED display
- **Keep Warm Function:** Maintains selected temperature for up to 30 minutes
- **Material:** Double-walled borosilicate glass body with a BPA-free polypropylene lid
- **Safety Features:** Automatic shut-off, boil-dry protection, and a cool-touch exterior
- **Energy Efficiency:** Rated 5 stars under Australian energy efficiency standards
- **Filtration:** Integrated removable scale filter for improved water quality
- **Warranty:** 2-year replacement warranty

### Pricing and Availability

The recommended retail price (RRP) for the EcoKettle Pro is **$129.00 AUD** (incl. GST). Trade and volume discount structures remain consistent with our existing product lines; please refer to the updated wholesale price list distributed earlier this week.

Orders should be placed through the usual channels. For any stock allocation questions, contact your regional Karingal sales representative.

### Marketing and Point-of-Sale Materials

To support the launch, we have prepared a full suite of marketing collateral, now available for download from the partner portal:

- Digital shelf images and lifestyle photography (high and low resolution)
- In-store display signage (A4 and A5)
- Product comparison chart (EcoKettle Pro vs. previous EcoKettle model)
- Social media assets for retailer use
- QR code linking to the product page on the Karingal website

Retailers are encouraged to use these materials to highlight the product's energy-saving features and precision temperature control, which are key differentiators in the current market.

### Training and Support

A short product training video (approx. 6 minutes) is available on the partner portal. It covers the key features, operating instructions, and common customer questions. We recommend that all retail staff view this before the product reaches shelves.

For technical or warranty-related enquiries, please contact the Karingal support team via the usual channels. Our customer service team has been briefed on the product specifications.

We thank you for your continued partnership and look forward to a successful launch.

Kind regards,

**Karingal Product Management**
Karingal Appliances Pty Ltd
Melbourne, VIC

A: The EcoKettle Pro includes a 2-year replacement warranty. Customers can contact our support team directly, or return the unit to the point of purchase. For in-store returns, please follow the standard Karingal warranty return procedure, which is unchanged from the previous EcoKettle model.

**Q: Does the kettle come with a power cord that meets Australian standards?**
A: Yes. The unit ships with a 1.2 m cord fitted with an AS/NZS 3112 compliant three-pin plug. This is the same plug used across our current appliance range.

### Product Benefits at a Glance

To assist your team in conversations with customers, here is a summary of the key selling points:

- **Precision temperature control:** Five preset temperatures (70°C, 80°C, 85°C, 90°C, and 100°C) allow customers to brew green tea, white tea, pour-over coffee, French press, or simply boil water without guesswork.
- **Fast boiling:** 1.7 L capacity boils in approximately 4 minutes, which is noticeably faster than the previous EcoKettle model.

documents.title: Test Report TR-2026-0142: EcoKettle Pro Performance Evaluation
documents.content:
Test Report TR-2026-0142 documents the performance evaluation of the EcoKettle Pro (model EKP-210) fitted with the revised heating element assembly. The evaluation was conducted at Brighton Test Labs between 14 July 2026 and 17 July 2026, with the final report compiled on 21 July 2026. The test result is PASS. This determination is current as of the date of issue and supersedes the provisional findings circulated in TR-2026-0141 (draft) on 18 July 2026.

**9.2 Basis for the determination**

The PASS determination is based on the full set of criteria agreed with Karingal Appliances prior to the commencement of testing. These criteria are listed in Section 2 of this report and cover:

- maximum boil time under standard fill (1.7 L, ambient temp 23°C, humidity 45%);
- run-to-run consistency across ten consecutive boil cycles;
- automatic shut-off function and timing;
- lid seal integrity during boiling;
- base stability and anti-rock behaviour;
- external surface temperature at maximum fill; and
- absence of localised hot spots on the base plate.

All criteria were met within the specified tolerances. No safety-related deviations were recorded. A summary of the pass/fail status for each criterion is provided in Table 9.1 below.

**Table 9.1 – Summary of results by criterion**

| Criterion | Specification | Measured result | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Maximum boil time (mean of 10 runs) | ≤ 190 s | 180 s | PASS |
| Run-to-run consistency (standard deviation) | ≤ 1.5 s | 0.89 s | PASS |
| Automatic shut-off activation | Within 5 s of boil detection | 2 s | PASS |
| Lid seal – steam leakage | No visible leakage | None observed | PASS |
| Base stability | No rocking movement | None observed | PASS |
| External surface temperature | ≤ 65 °C at side wall | 58 °C | PASS |
| Base plate hot spots | No localised discolouration | None observed | PASS |

**9.3 Interpretation of results**

The results confirm that the revised heating element assembly in the EKP-210 performs to the target specification set by Karingal Appliances. The mean boil time of 180 s is 30 s shorter than the pre-revision unit tested under identical conditions, representing a practical improvement of approximately 14 % in time-to-boil. For a household using the kettle three times per day, this equates to a saving of roughly 90 s per day, or approximately 10.5 hours per year.

Test Report TR-2026-0142 test result is PASS. Record status: current.

The run-to-run standard deviation of 0.89 s indicates that the revised assembly delivers more consistent performance than the pre-revision unit (1.58 s). This improvement is attributable to the revised heating element configuration, which provides more direct thermal contact with the base plate and produces a more uniform heating pattern.

No adverse effects on safety or durability were observed as a result of the faster boil time. The automatic shut-off, lid seal, and base stability all performed within specification throughout the repeat testing.

**9.4 Limitations**

The following limitations apply to this evaluation:

- Testing was conducted on a single production-representative unit supplied by Karingal Appliances. Statistical inference to the broader production population is limited accordingly.
- All testing was performed under controlled laboratory conditions (ambient temp 23°C, humidity 45%). Performance at extreme ambient conditions has not been assessed.
- Long-term durability (beyond the 100-cycle endurance test described in Section 8.5) is outside the scope of this evaluation.
- The comparison with pre-revision data relies on test records from TR-2026-0138, which was conducted under the same conditions and remains on file at Brighton Test Labs.

**9.5 Recommendation**

On the basis of the results presented in this report, Brighton Test Labs recommends that Karingal Appliances proceed with the revised heating element assembly for the EKP-210. The revision meets the agreed performance criteria and introduces no observed safety concerns.
